scope: Product early charge-inhibit request/readback and manual read-only diagnostics; no charge enable, motor control or vendor changes

battery_source.type: User-provided manufacturer generic parameters image, combined with prior 500mAh ZCLP500 label
battery_source.limits: Generic brand image is not a model-specific protection-board datasheet. Image says protected and special models use their applicable lower limits; those remain unverified. Its charge-before-use statement is not execution authorization.

charger_datasheet.charge_current_formula: (REG02[5:0]+1)*8mA in normal mode; special mode requires REG0B
charger_datasheet.limits: Reference E datasheet is not proof of fitted IC identity, temperature sensing, pre-application physical charge inhibition or live register values.

source_inspection.product_early_hook: Official HAL_RAM_RET_CODE_SECT retained SRAM override. DEEP false path only SRAM instructions; true HAL path supports cold startup only. PM_STANDBY_ENABLE is compile-blocked.
source_inspection.sdk_driver_exclusion: Final config BSP_USING_CHARGER unset; main.elf has project strong BSP_PowerUpCustom and wf_charger, no aw32001_init or aw32001_charge_enable. Original weak BSP_PowerUpCustom section is discarded.
source_inspection.bootloader: Independent bootloader.elf has strong HAL_MspInit; its disassembly is a watchdog-disable register store and return. No BSP_PowerUpCustom, BSP_Power_Up or BSP_IO_Init symbols are retained. No Product override is present in that image; ROM and retained-register state remain unverified.
source_inspection.hal_timeout: Configured HAL transfer timeout 20ms; precheck rejects already-BUSY. SDK has separate 1000ms BUSY wait, so 20ms is not a guaranteed whole-call deadline. Hardware race and fault duration unverified.
source_inspection.failure_semantics: Stop without retry, never write CEB=0, verification remains false on any failure. Failed communication means physical inhibition unconfirmed, not fail-closed hardware proof.
source_inspection.review: Independent read-only review found SDK fixed BUSY timeout; precheck added and residual SDK bound documented. Core no-enable/failure semantics and early ABI/shared I2C restore reviewed.
source_inspection.final_review: Independent final read-only review found no implementation blockers within cold boot/ordinary DEEP scope; confirmed no-enable invariant, SDK exclusion, retained SRAM hook, read-only snapshots and layout gate boundary.

host_validation.coverage: Previously enabled/POR state/unrelated flags; each of seven transfer failures; ACK without write effect; final lost CEB; null arguments; never-enable write invariant
host_validation.limits: Portable protocol test only; no HAL timing, board GPIO, actual charging or UI/PM acceptance

hardware_verification.intentional_startup_reset: RTS 150ms after flash to capture new startup, independently recorded

failed_candidate.user_result: After short KEY1 screen did not wake; user unplugged USB and restarted, screen lit, then KEY1 failed again
failed_candidate.capture_error: SerialException/GetOverlappedResult PermissionError at user USB unplug; no KEY/assert logged after first screen-off
failed_candidate.source_cause: SDK calls custom hook before NOR Flash release from DPD. Old weak hook was SRAM 0x20008748; new strong hook incorrectly occupied Flash 0x12099c10, even on false return path.
failed_candidate.remedy: Retained SRAM hook using official HAL_RAM_RET_CODE_SECT; verify false path disassembly. PM_STANDBY_ENABLE is compile-blocked because its early HAL call chain still uses Flash.

ram_fixed_candidate_failure.user_result: User reports KEY1 still cannot wake after RAM-corrected candidate
ram_fixed_candidate_failure.raw_fault_limit: REG09 0x20 input fault raw value is not diagnosed; REG08 power-good is observed, not a continuous electrical guarantee
ram_fixed_candidate_failure.interpretation: Retained SRAM placement is corrected, but device failure persists. Driver-exclusion and CEB power-path effects remain hypotheses; do not attribute whole fault solely to the first layout defect.

baseline_restoration.limits: Restored baseline retains SDK automatic charging; USB-only and battery disconnected remain required. One wake regression only; not a continuous sleep/current claim.

ceb_only_comparison.purpose: Separate late CEB inhibition from early override/SDK initialization exclusion under USB-only conditions; diagnostic only
ceb_only_comparison.hardware_result: failed KEY1 after late CEB-only inhibition; initial KEY1 passed within same diagnostic boot
ceb_only_comparison.limits: Preserves original automatic charger initialization; late inhibit is not production default inhibition or H2 closure. Keep battery disconnected.
ceb_only_comparison.after_inhibit_user_result: 禁充后 ，熄屏前正常，但是现在按键key无法点亮屏幕
ceb_only_comparison.interpretation: Full SDK/PA44 initialization and original SRAM hook were retained. Driver exclusion or early custom hook are not necessary conditions for this failure. CEB=1 plus screen-off reproduced it; underlying electrical/DEEP cause remains unproven.

ceb_idle_comparison.user_result: 现在按key还是无法点亮屏幕
ceb_idle_comparison.interpretation: KEY1 failure reproduces with DEEP inhibited; UART shell and scheduler remain responsive. Does not establish electrical cause or actual KEY waveform.

software_wake_comparison.first_short_window_result: Screen-on logged for about ten seconds; user did not observe it, not treated as visual failure
software_wake_comparison.bounded_observation: Eight wf_pm wake commands spaced eight seconds apart; no charge writes or reset
software_wake_comparison.interpretation: CEB=1 with IDLE hold can visibly restore display by software event. Evidence narrows failure to KEY1 trigger path; pin voltage/IRQ and fitted circuit remain unmeasured.
software_wake_comparison.screen_off_i2c_read: One manual status while screen off failed after SDK 5s wait and automatic I2C recovery clocks; physical CEB state at that instant was unconfirmed. Later lit readback is 0xAC.

final_baseline_restoration.status: write/verify passed; user confirms KEY1 normal
final_baseline_restoration.limits: Keep USB-only battery disconnected because baseline automatic charging is retained.

official_design_reference.primary_spot_check: Primary independently fetched official archive, verified switch component, net/endpoint records and symbol terminal offsets. No custom exporter or hardware changes.
official_design_reference.datasheet_fact: AW32001E V1.4 p16: OPSM CEB=1 enables IN->SYS only; CEB=0 turns on Q2 for charging.
official_design_reference.inference: In USB-only battery-absent CEB=1 state, KEY1 VBAT source may lack a valid high level. This fits live shell/software display wake and absent KEY1, but actual node voltage/fitted PCB/IC remain unmeasured.
official_design_reference.limits: V1.2 design uses SY6103 symbol with compatible AW32001E note; not proof of fitted component or real node voltage. No visual CAD rendering or live electrical measurement.
